title: payment-api error-rate SLO burn
description: Elevated latency on payment-api (p95 13.2s) with rising errors reported by consumers.
root_cause_detail: An error path introduced in payment-api v3.5.0 did not return connections to the pool; the pool (max 10) saturated gradually and requests queued until the acquisition timeout.
expected_symptoms: connection acquisition timeouts and database errors in payment-api logs
payment-api p95 latency rises from ~193ms to ~13.2s
payment-api memory stays near baseline; CPU at most moderately elevated
utilization climbs gradually after deployment of payment-api v3.5.0
resolution: Rolled back payment-api to v3.4.12, fixed the missing connection release and enabled pool leak detection.
